name: howto
title: The five-minute privacy pass on a new speaker
sub: Do these before you ask it anything
footer: Paths from the makers' privacy pages, read November 6, 2026; app menus change.

items.head: Pick the history
items.body: Alexa: set auto-delete to 3 months or choose not to save. Google: leave 18 months or shorten it.

items.head: Keep training off
items.body: On Google, leave the voice and audio improvement setting off. On Apple, decline Improve Siri.

items.head: Find the mute
items.body: Echo has a mic button, Google and Era 100 have a switch, HomePod mutes by voice or the Home app.

items.head: Check the plan
items.body: Alexa+ is free only with Prime. Gemini Live needs a Premium plan.

items.head: Delete old audio
items.body: Use the app path for your brand once a quarter; Echo: More, Alexa Privacy.

items.head: Or skip the mic
items.body: If the room is private, the Sonos Era 100 SL has no microphones at all.
